devdoc.author: Tellor Inc.
devdoc.details: This contract holds staking functions, tallyVotes and updateDisputeFee Because of space limitations and will be consolidated in future iterations*

decimals().details: Allows users to access the number of decimals

depositStake().details: This function allows miners to deposit their stake.

didMine(bytes32,address).details: This function tells you if a given challenge has been completed by a given miner

params._miner: address that you want to know if they solved the challenge

returns._0: true if the _miner address provided solved the

didVote(uint256,address).details: Checks if an address voted in a given dispute

returns._0: bool of whether or not party voted

getAddressVars(bytes32).details: allows Tellor to read data from the addressVars mapping

params._data: is the keccak256("variable_name") of the variable that is being accessed. These are examples of how the variables are saved within other functions: addressVars[keccak256("_owner")] addressVars[keccak256("tellorContract")]

returns._0: address of the requested variable

bytes32 hash of dispute bool executed where true if it has been voted on bool disputeVotePassed bool isPropFork true if the dispute is a proposed fork address of reportedMiner address of reportingParty address of proposedForkAddress uint of requestId uint of timestamp uint of value uint of minExecutionDate uint of numberOfVotes uint of blocknumber uint of minerSlot uint of quorum uint of fee int count of the current tally

getDisputeIdByDisputeHash(bytes32).details: Checks if a given hash of miner,requestId has been disputed

returns._0: uint disputeId

getDisputeUintVars(uint256,bytes32).details: Checks for uint variables in the disputeUintVars mapping based on the disputeId

params._data: the variable to pull from the mapping. _data = keccak256("variable_name") where variable_name is the variables/strings used to save the data in the mapping. The variables names are commented out under the disputeUintVars under the Dispute struct

returns._0: uint value for the bytes32 data submitted

getLastNewValueById(uint256).details: Gets the a value for the latest timestamp available

returns._0: value for timestamp of last proof of work submitted and if true if it exist or 0 and false if it doesn't

params._timestamp: is the timestamp to look up blocknumber

returns._0: uint of the blocknumber which the dispute was mined

getMinersByRequestIdAndTimestamp(uint256.details: Gets the 5 miners who mined the value for the specified requestId/_timestamp

params._timestamp: is the timestamp to look up miners for

returns._0: the 5 miners' addresses

getNewCurrentVariables().details: Getter function for the requestId being mined returns the currentChallenge, array of requestIDs, difficulty, and the current Tip of the 5 IDs

getNewValueCountbyRequestId(uint256).details: Counts the number of values that have been submitted for the request if called for the currentRequest being mined it can tell you how many miners have submitted a value for that request so far

returns._0: uint count of the number of values received for the requestId

getNewVariablesOnDeck().details: Getter function for next requestIds on queue/request with highest payouts at time the function is called

getRequestIdByRequestQIndex(uint256).details: Getter function for the specified requestQ index

params._index: to look up in the requestQ array

returns._0: uint of requestId

getRequestQ().details: Getter function for the requestQ array

returns._0: the requestQ array

getRequestUintVars(uint256,bytes32).details: Allows access to the uint variables saved in the apiUintVars under the requestDetails struct for the requestId specified

params._data: the variable to pull from the mapping. _data = keccak256("variable_name") where variable_name is the variables/strings used to save the data in the mapping. The variables names are in TellorVariables.sol

returns._0: uint value of the apiUintVars specified in _data for the requestId specified

getRequestVars(uint256).details: Gets the API struct variables that are not mappings

returns._0: uint of index in requestQ array
returns._1: uint of current payout/tip for this requestId

getStakerInfo(address).details: This function allows users to retrieve all information about a staker

returns._0: uint current state of staker

getSubmissionsByTimestamp(uint256,uint25.details: Gets the 5 miners who mined the value for the specified requestId/_timestamp

params._timestamp: is the timestamp to look up miners for

returns._0: address[5] array of 5 addresses of miners that mined the requestId

getTimestampbyRequestIDandIndex(uint256,.details: Gets the timestamp for the value based on their index

params._index: is the value index to look up
params._requestID: is the requestId to look up

returns._0: uint timestamp

getTopRequestIDs().details: Getter function for the top 5 requests with highest payouts. This function is used within the getNewVariablesOnDeck function

getUintVar(bytes32).details: Getter for the variables saved under the TellorStorageStruct uints variable

params._data: the variable to pull from the mapping. _data = keccak256("variable_name") where variable_name is the variables/strings used to save the data in the mapping. The variables names in the TellorVariables contract

returns._0: uint of specified variable

isInDispute(uint256,uint256).details: Gets the 5 miners who mined the value for the specified requestId/_timestamp

params._timestamp: is the timestamp to look up miners for

returns._0: bool true if requestId/timestamp is under dispute

name().details: Allows users to access the token's name

requestStakingWithdraw().details: This function allows stakers to request to withdraw their stake (no longer stake) once they lock for withdraw(stakes.currentStatus = 2) they are locked for 7 days before they can withdraw the deposit

retrieveData(uint256,uint256).details: Retrieve value from oracle based on timestamp

returns._0: value for timestamp submitted

symbol().details: Allows users to access the token's symbol

tallyVotes(uint256).details: tallies the votes and locks the stake disbursement(currentStatus = 4) if the vote passes

totalSupply().details: Getter for the total_supply of oracle tokens

returns._0: uint total supply

updateMinDisputeFee().details: This function updates the minimum dispute fee as a function of the amount of staked miners

updateTellor(uint256).details: Updates the Tellor address after a proposed fork has passed the vote and day has gone by without a dispute

params._disputeId: the disputeId for the proposed fork

withdrawStake().details: This function allows users to withdraw their stake after a 7 day waiting period from request

devdoc.author: Tellor Inc.
devdoc.details: Main functionality for Tellor Oracle system*

addTip(uint256,uint256).details: Add tip to a request ID

params._tip: amount the requester is willing to pay to be get on queue. Miners mine the ID with the highest tip

allowance(address,address).details: Getter function for remaining spender balance

params._spender: address of spender of parties said balance
params._user: address of party with the balance

returns._0: Returns the remaining allowance of tokens granted to the _spender from the _user

allowedToTrade(address,uint256).details: This function returns whether or not a given user is allowed to trade a given amount and removing the staked amount from their balance if they are staked

params._amount: to check if the user can spend

returns._0: true if they are allowed to spend the amount being checked

approve(address,uint256).details: This function approves a _spender an _amount of tokens to use

params._amount: amount the spender is being approved for

returns._0: true if spender approved successfully

params._user: is the owner address used to look up the balance

returns._0: Returns the balance associated with the passed in _user

balanceOfAt(address,uint256).details: Queries the balance of _user at a specific _blockNumber

params._blockNumber: The block number when the balance is queried
params._user: The address from which the balance will be retrieved

returns._0: The balance at _blockNumber specified

beginDispute(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: Helps initialize a dispute by assigning it a disputeId when a miner returns a false/bad value on the validate array(in Tellor.ProofOfWork) it sends the invalidated value information to POS voting

params._minerIndex: the index of the miner that submitted the value being disputed. Since each official value requires 5 miners to submit a value.

migrate().details: This function allows users to swap old trb tokens for new ones based on the user's old Tellor balance

migrateFor(address,uint256,bool).details: This is function used by the migrator to help  swap old trb tokens for new ones based on the user's old Tellor balance

params._amount: is the amount to mint to the user
params._bypass: whether or not to bypass the check if they migrated already
params._destination: is the address that will receive tokens

proposeFork(address).details: Allows for a fork to be proposed

submitMiningSolution(string,uint256[5],u.details: This function allows miners to submit their mining solution and data requested

params._requestIds: are the 5 request ids being mined
params._values: are the 5 values corresponding to the 5 request ids

transfer(address,uint256).details: Allows for a transfer of tokens to _to

params._amount: The amount of tokens to send
params._to: The address to send tokens to

params._amount: The amount of tokens to be transferred
params._from: The address holding the tokens being transferred

unlockDisputeFee(uint256).details: Allows disputer to unlock the dispute fee

verify().details: Used during upgrade process to verify valid Tellor Contract

params._supportsDispute: is the vote (true=the dispute has basis false = vote against dispute)

devdoc.author: Tellor Inc.
devdoc.details: Getter functions for Tellor Oracle system

decimals().details: Allows users to access the number of decimals

didMine(bytes32,address).details: This function tells you if a given challenge has been completed by a given miner

params._miner: address that you want to know if they solved the challenge

returns._0: true if the _miner address provided solved the

didVote(uint256,address).details: Checks if an address voted in a given dispute

returns._0: bool of whether or not party voted

getAddressVars(bytes32).details: allows Tellor to read data from the addressVars mapping

params._data: is the keccak256("variable_name") of the variable that is being accessed. These are examples of how the variables are saved within other functions: addressVars[keccak256("_owner")] addressVars[keccak256("tellorContract")]

returns._0: address of the requested variable

bytes32 hash of dispute bool executed where true if it has been voted on bool disputeVotePassed bool isPropFork true if the dispute is a proposed fork address of reportedMiner address of reportingParty address of proposedForkAddress uint of requestId uint of timestamp uint of value uint of minExecutionDate uint of numberOfVotes uint of blocknumber uint of minerSlot uint of quorum uint of fee int count of the current tally

getDisputeIdByDisputeHash(bytes32).details: Checks if a given hash of miner,requestId has been disputed

returns._0: uint disputeId

getDisputeUintVars(uint256,bytes32).details: Checks for uint variables in the disputeUintVars mapping based on the disputeId

params._data: the variable to pull from the mapping. _data = keccak256("variable_name") where variable_name is the variables/strings used to save the data in the mapping. The variables names are commented out under the disputeUintVars under the Dispute struct

returns._0: uint value for the bytes32 data submitted

getLastNewValueById(uint256).details: Gets the a value for the latest timestamp available

returns._0: value for timestamp of last proof of work submitted and if true if it exist or 0 and false if it doesn't

params._timestamp: is the timestamp to look up blocknumber

returns._0: uint of the blocknumber which the dispute was mined

getMinersByRequestIdAndTimestamp(uint256.details: Gets the 5 miners who mined the value for the specified requestId/_timestamp

params._timestamp: is the timestamp to look up miners for

returns._0: the 5 miners' addresses

getNewCurrentVariables().details: Getter function for the requestId being mined returns the currentChallenge, array of requestIDs, difficulty, and the current Tip of the 5 IDs

getNewValueCountbyRequestId(uint256).details: Counts the number of values that have been submitted for the request if called for the currentRequest being mined it can tell you how many miners have submitted a value for that request so far

returns._0: uint count of the number of values received for the requestId

getNewVariablesOnDeck().details: Getter function for next requestIds on queue/request with highest payouts at time the function is called

getRequestIdByRequestQIndex(uint256).details: Getter function for the specified requestQ index

params._index: to look up in the requestQ array

returns._0: uint of requestId

getRequestQ().details: Getter function for the requestQ array

returns._0: the requestQ array

getRequestUintVars(uint256,bytes32).details: Allows access to the uint variables saved in the apiUintVars under the requestDetails struct for the requestId specified

params._data: the variable to pull from the mapping. _data = keccak256("variable_name") where variable_name is the variables/strings used to save the data in the mapping. The variables names are in TellorVariables.sol

returns._0: uint value of the apiUintVars specified in _data for the requestId specified

getRequestVars(uint256).details: Gets the API struct variables that are not mappings

returns._0: uint of index in requestQ array
returns._1: uint of current payout/tip for this requestId

getStakerInfo(address).details: This function allows users to retrieve all information about a staker

returns._0: uint current state of staker

getSubmissionsByTimestamp(uint256,uint25.details: Gets the 5 miners who mined the value for the specified requestId/_timestamp

params._timestamp: is the timestamp to look up miners for

returns._0: address[5] array of 5 addresses of miners that mined the requestId

getTimestampbyRequestIDandIndex(uint256,.details: Gets the timestamp for the value based on their index

params._index: is the value index to look up
params._requestID: is the requestId to look up

returns._0: uint timestamp

getTopRequestIDs().details: Getter function for the top 5 requests with highest payouts. This function is used within the getNewVariablesOnDeck function

getUintVar(bytes32).details: Getter for the variables saved under the TellorStorageStruct uints variable

params._data: the variable to pull from the mapping. _data = keccak256("variable_name") where variable_name is the variables/strings used to save the data in the mapping. The variables names in the TellorVariables contract

returns._0: uint of specified variable

isInDispute(uint256,uint256).details: Gets the 5 miners who mined the value for the specified requestId/_timestamp

params._timestamp: is the timestamp to look up miners for

returns._0: bool true if requestId/timestamp is under dispute

name().details: Allows users to access the token's name

retrieveData(uint256,uint256).details: Retrieve value from oracle based on timestamp

returns._0: value for timestamp submitted

symbol().details: Allows users to access the token's symbol

totalSupply().details: Getter for the total_supply of oracle tokens

returns._0: uint total supply

devdoc.author: Tellor Inc.
devdoc.details: Contains the methods related to initiating disputes and voting on them. Because of space limitations some functions are currently on the Extensions contract

allowance(address,address).details: Getter function for remaining spender balance

params._spender: address of spender of parties said balance
params._user: address of party with the balance

returns._0: Returns the remaining allowance of tokens granted to the _spender from the _user

allowedToTrade(address,uint256).details: This function returns whether or not a given user is allowed to trade a given amount and removing the staked amount from their balance if they are staked

params._amount: to check if the user can spend

returns._0: true if they are allowed to spend the amount being checked

approve(address,uint256).details: This function approves a _spender an _amount of tokens to use

params._amount: amount the spender is being approved for

returns._0: true if spender approved successfully

params._user: is the owner address used to look up the balance

returns._0: Returns the balance associated with the passed in _user

balanceOfAt(address,uint256).details: Queries the balance of _user at a specific _blockNumber

params._blockNumber: The block number when the balance is queried
params._user: The address from which the balance will be retrieved

returns._0: The balance at _blockNumber specified

beginDispute(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: Helps initialize a dispute by assigning it a disputeId when a miner returns a false/bad value on the validate array(in Tellor.ProofOfWork) it sends the invalidated value information to POS voting

params._minerIndex: the index of the miner that submitted the value being disputed. Since each official value requires 5 miners to submit a value.

proposeFork(address).details: Allows for a fork to be proposed

transfer(address,uint256).details: Allows for a transfer of tokens to _to

params._amount: The amount of tokens to send
params._to: The address to send tokens to

params._amount: The amount of tokens to be transferred
params._from: The address holding the tokens being transferred

unlockDisputeFee(uint256).details: Allows disputer to unlock the dispute fee

verify().details: Used during upgrade process to verify valid Tellor Contract

params._supportsDispute: is the vote (true=the dispute has basis false = vote against dispute)

devdoc.author: Tellor Inc.
devdoc.details: Contains the methods related to transfers and ERC20, its storage and hashes of tellor variables that are used to save gas on transactions.

allowance(address,address).details: Getter function for remaining spender balance

params._spender: address of spender of parties said balance
params._user: address of party with the balance

returns._0: Returns the remaining allowance of tokens granted to the _spender from the _user

allowedToTrade(address,uint256).details: This function returns whether or not a given user is allowed to trade a given amount and removing the staked amount from their balance if they are staked

params._amount: to check if the user can spend

returns._0: true if they are allowed to spend the amount being checked

approve(address,uint256).details: This function approves a _spender an _amount of tokens to use

params._amount: amount the spender is being approved for

returns._0: true if spender approved successfully

params._user: is the owner address used to look up the balance

returns._0: Returns the balance associated with the passed in _user

balanceOfAt(address,uint256).details: Queries the balance of _user at a specific _blockNumber

params._blockNumber: The block number when the balance is queried
params._user: The address from which the balance will be retrieved

returns._0: The balance at _blockNumber specified

transfer(address,uint256).details: Allows for a transfer of tokens to _to

params._amount: The amount of tokens to send
params._to: The address to send tokens to

params._amount: The amount of tokens to be transferred
params._from: The address holding the tokens being transferred
